Q1.question: On-time delivery for India warehouses last month
Q1.note: The descriptive path. 'last month' resolves against AS_OF_DATE to July 2026; the window is cut on promised_delivery_date, the metric's declared time dimension. Cutting it on order_date instead returns 33/40 = 82.5% -- plausible, precise, and wrong by 4.8pp.

Q2.question: Why did on-time delivery drop for India warehouses last month?
Q2.note: The diagnostic path. Same metric, same filters, same window as Q1 -- the only additions are the attribution dimension and the comparison window. That is the point: 'why' is answered by grouping a governed metric on a governed derived dimension, not by a different query.
